headline: Comilla: Tenant kills landlord, dismembers body
summary: A shocking crime in Comilla where a tenant allegedly murdered their landlord and cut the body into pieces to hide the evidence.
details: In a gruesome incident in Comilla, a tenant allegedly killed their landlord and dismembered the body into nine pieces.
The suspect reportedly stored the body parts in polythene bags to conceal the crime.
Local authorities were alerted to the incident, leading to the discovery of the remains.
Police have launched an investigation to determine the motive behind the killing and to apprehend the suspect if they are still at large.
The community is in shock over the brutality of the crime and the relationship between the victim and the perpetrator.
